title: Oracle Trucking Gas to Keep Data Centers on Track
text: Oracle is using a new power strategy to keep many of its data centers on track: trucking natural gas directly to the server farms. The company is considering using this approach to speed up a build in New Mexico, where a gas pipeline needed to help power one of its crucial data centers is delayed. Bloomberg's Brody Ford joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech" to discuss Oracle's strategy. (Source: Bloomberg)
